binding: Exact future operation/output_digest/destination/session/route/release/consumption tuple; symbolic IDs here convey no authority

traces.name: Positively established local-only operation
steps: Authoritative closed attempt state establishes no admission, permit, buffer or transport dispatch for O1
required_assertions: Label depends on positive complete authoritative no-dispatch evidence
No automatic send is authorized by the label
forbidden: Infer no-dispatch from only an absent ACK or attempt row

traces.name: Actual remote receipt with lost ACK
steps: R2 release and P2 consumption committed for exact output/destination
Remote destination actually receives output in stipulated future fixture ground truth
ACK is lost; authority-side observer has no confirming remote receipt
traces.expected_display: Transmission may have occurred; delivery is unknown. Checking status only.
required_assertions: Local observer does not know stipulated remote ground truth
Only bounded access-controlled read-only lookup of O2 is possible
forbidden: New idempotency key to bypass uncertainty

traces.name: Unknown delivery then revoke or cancel
steps: Relevant revocation or scoped cancellation commits
traces.expected_display: Delivery of the earlier attempt is unknown. Further sharing is now blocked.
required_assertions: Lookup itself remains access-controlled; if unavailable uncertainty remains
forbidden: Rewrite prior delivery as NOT_SENT or SUPPRESSED
Treat cancellation as proof worker terminated

traces.name: Late matching delivery report after revoke
steps: Authenticated destination later reports receipt for exact O2/R2/P2/output/destination tuple
traces.expected_display: Delivery of the earlier attempt was reported; receipt by a person is unconfirmed. Further sharing remains blocked.
required_assertions: Append report and retain earlier unknown observation
No repeated send or permission from historical report

traces.name: Mismatched or duplicate acknowledgement
steps: Receive report for wrong output digest or destination
Receive duplicate report for previously accepted exact tuple
traces.expected_display: Wrong-tuple report cannot settle O2; duplicate matching report does not create a new delivery operation
required_assertions: Mismatch remains auditable but cannot replace O2 uncertainty
forbidden: Use ACK absence/presence without exact binding
Treat duplicate ACK as another grant use

traces.name: Incomplete attempt ledger or ambiguous failure
steps: Attempt ledger unavailable, missing, or error semantics do not establish no transmission
traces.expected_display: Transmission may have occurred; delivery is unknown.
required_assertions: Unknown status is not inferred local-only
Read-only reconciliation or explicit unavailable status
